title: Record four-book THE BATTERIES and separate NPD variants gaps

packet.note: No M17-04 packet exists: docs/tasks/M17 holds M17-01..03 and M17-05..07 only, and the M17 milestone links M17-04 to TODO.md. Scope here is the TODO line plus this task statement, not a packet.

method: Enumerate only what this repository holds for the four-book THE BATTERIES structure and for NPD. A reported count stays a count; no book title, variant name, sequence or page is invented. Every non-ABSENT row carries one file:line quote that the validator must find verbatim on that line. NPD works are a separate set from the book set and are never counted as books.

status_definitions.EVIDENCED: The named referent itself is present at the cited locator as an in-repository label or typed row (for example the ensemble label and its O008 identity). It does not mean a book, page, manuscript, scene or variant is present.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: The repository holds the referent only as a count, an editorial heading, a label set, or a report that explicitly calls the structure incompletely recovered. At least one required attribute (title, sequence, page, mapping) is missing.
status_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: The repository names the label and a cited locator records its content, page, sequence, mapping or source as missing. The locator documents the gap, not the artifact.
status_definitions.ABSENT: The repository names the category but holds no instance and no locator asserts one. The empty set is recorded here rather than filled; an ABSENT row therefore has no source.

set_definitions.BATTERIES_FOUR_BOOK: Rows about the reported four-book THE BATTERIES narrative structure. Contains zero book rows and zero book titles.
set_definitions.NPD_WORKS: Rows about the NPD works/labels. NPD is not a fifth BATTERIES book and is not part of the four-book count.
set_definitions.BATTERIES_NPD_SEPARATION: Rows recording the only in-repository relation between the two sets. A relation is not a merge.

rows.label: THE BATTERIES (fictional ensemble)
rows.referent: The fictional ensemble label only; not a book, manuscript or page.
rows.gap: The ensemble label is present and typed as O008 in the ontology. No book, page, manuscript, transcript or media manifest for the ensemble exists in this repository.

rows.label: VII. THE BATTERIES — Chaos Medic (39–45)
rows.referent: Seven editorial chapter slots (39-45) printed under one band heading.
rows.gap: The band holds seven editorial slot headings, not four books. No mapping from any slot to a book, and no statement that a slot is a book, is recorded.

rows.label: THE BATTERIES four-book structure (count = 4)
rows.referent: A reported count of four books; no individual book is named.
rows.gap: Only the count is reported, and the same line calls the structure incompletely recovered. No title, index, sequence, page range, edition, transcript or per-book locator exists, so this row is one count and not four sourced books.

rows.label: Individual THE BATTERIES book titles
rows.referent: The four book titles, if any.

source.quote: The four books have **no individual titles anywhere**.

rows.gap: Zero of the four books has a title in this repository. No title may be minted from the band headings, the NPD labels or the ensemble name.

rows.label: THE BATTERIES book order and chronology
rows.referent: The sequence, publication order and dates of the four books.

source.quote: No publication dates, production dates or book order.

rows.gap: No book order, publication date, production date or chronology is recorded; book one through book four cannot be placed or ranked.

rows.label: THE BATTERIES book pages, scenes and transcripts
rows.referent: Page and scene content for any of the four books.

source.quote: No title, page count, page range, scene list, edition or transcript exists.

rows.gap: Missing scene/pages are marked NEEDS_SOURCE: no page count, page range, scene list, edition or transcript exists for any of the four books.

rows.label: NPD named labels: 24:27, 24:37, 25:50
rows.referent: Three timestamp-like NPD labels reported as different works.

source.quote: Episodes/tokens include **NPD TEAM 24:27**, **24:37 — TARIAN KIDS**, **25:50 — TARIAN HUJAN**

rows.gap: Three NPD labels are printed, but they are episode/token labels, not scenes or pages. The same document (:973) says the exact NPD page/scene/media order is incompletely recovered and that the three are different works.

rows.label: NPD page, scene and media order
rows.referent: The exact order of NPD pages, scenes and media.

source.quote: exact NPD page/scene/media order remain incompletely recovered

rows.gap: NPD page/scene/media order is recorded as incompletely recovered. No ordered list, page number, scene list or media manifest exists, so no sequence can be asserted.

rows.label: Editorial slot 41 NPD TEAM
rows.referent: One editorial heading in the 99-slot index.
rows.gap: The index prints one heading named NPD TEAM. It is a heading, not a work, page or scene, and no mapping from it to 24:27, 24:37 or 25:50 is recorded.

rows.label: Named NPD variants
rows.referent: Any named NPD variant, its parent work and its relation.
rows.gap: No NPD variant name, id, parent work, relation or sequence exists anywhere in this repository. The three NPD labels are stated to be different works (:973), and the task phrase 'NPD variants' names no referent, so the set is empty rather than filled.

rows.label: NPD scene text, pages and media manifest
rows.referent: Any NPD scene text, page or media artifact.

source.quote: No page, scene text or media manifest

rows.gap: No NPD page, scene text or media manifest exists in the repository, and the 24:37 scene relation is still flagged for verification (:681).

rows.label: THE BATTERIES appearsIn NPD TEAM 24:37
rows.referent: The only recorded relation between the ensemble and an NPD work.
rows.gap: The recorded relation is appearsIn against a creative-brief source whose scene still needs verification. It is not identity, membership or a book assignment; no document maps NPD works into the four-book set.

non_claims: No THE BATTERIES book is named, numbered, titled, sequenced, paged or quoted; four is a reported count only.
No NPD variant is named. The three NPD labels are different works per :973, not variants of one work.
No NPD work is counted as a fifth BATTERIES book or merged into the four-book set.
No page, scene, transcript, manuscript or media byte is recovered, authenticated or reproduced.
No rights, licence or consent determination is made; no narrative text is copied.
No external archive, repository or website was fetched or opened.
limitations: The task has no packet; scope is the TODO line and this task statement, so no packet acceptance beyond 'Missing scene/pages marked NEEDS_SOURCE' is claimed.
The four-book count and the NPD labels come from a secondary XV vision report that itself says the structure is incompletely recovered; its underlying RECOVERY_GAPS_V10.md is not in this repository.
Three NPD labels are not an exhaustive NPD inventory; only labels printed at :370 are recorded.

The only tracked file matching 'batter' besides the M26-03 ledger is the project card image apps/headquarters/public/art/proj-batteries.jpg, whose rights are unresolved; it is not a book or page and is not counted.
Prior M26-03 rows are not reused as sources; its audit is cited only where it states the repository gap explicitly.
